description: baseline

CholeskyQR2 + Householder-reconstruction QR: a GEMM/tensor-core-dominant algorithm replacing per-panel reflector recurrence with big matmuls. Per matrix compute G=A^T@A (Triton/bmm), R=chol(G), Q=A@R^-1, repeat once (CholeskyQR2) for orthogonality, then RECONSTRUCT compact (H,tau) from (Q,R) via Householder so the output matches geqrf's contract and passes the gates. Must stay accurate on the guards' ill-conditioned rankdef/clustered/nearrank batches (fall back per-matrix to a Householder/geqrf path when chol fails, dispatching on numerics NOT conditioning-guessing). Route off-grid n to torch.geqrf. Targets compute-bound large n=1024/2048/4096.

BEST: 56240us = 2.09x baseline (117536), commit 48f95455 (algo 07aeafe7). Approach: shifted-CholeskyQR3 (Fukaya shift, GEMM-heavy A^TA/Q^TQ + Cholesky + TRSM) -> orthogonal Q,R -> reconstruct compact (H,tau) via modified unpivoted LU of Q (Yamamoto/orhr_col): tau_i=-U_ii*d_i, d_i=-sign(pivot), R_out=S*R. WHAT WORKED: (1) the math reproduces geqrf's contract exactly (residuals ~1e-5 vs gates 20/100); (2) the KEY win was a custom TRITON diag-block kernel for the modified-LU that does the nb=64 sequential elimination in REGISTERS (collapsing ~2000 tiny torch ops into n/64 launches) -- this alone took 1.14x->1.91x; an earlier full-panel-in-global-memory Triton kernel RACED (global RAW hazard, n=352 residual 20.7) and was the lesson; (3) per-matrix numerical fallback gated on Cholesky info+NaN+cheap column-norm (NO extra GEMM, NOT conditioning-guessing) -- empirically exact; (4) staged early-bail per pass so ill-conditioned matrices exit before wasting O(n^3) passes; (5) route n=32 to geqrf (8.6x faster there). Per-shape vs geqrf: n=176 6.2x, n=352 8.6x, n=512 dense 7.6x, clustered 7.8x, n=1024 2.5x. WHAT DIDN'T: TF32/bf16 Grams DESTROY accuracy (orth 1e-5->1e-2, fallbacks 24->376) even on well-conditioned late passes -- CholeskyQR is hard precision-bound to fp32 SIMT GEMMs here; 2 passes insufficient; column-scaling mixed; gated recovery of pass-1 failers net-neutral. REMAINING LOSSES (still <1x vs geqrf): rankdef-512 (0.91x, 100% fallback+wasted pass-0 Gram), n=4096 (0.28->improved with early-bail), nearrank (100% fallback) -- these are hard geqrf floors for genuinely-singular matrices.
